Road conditions

  • 866-282-7579-Road conditions (from outside NH); 511 (from inside NH)
  • http://hb.511nh.com/main.jsf (Road conditions)

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide,
  • Over 13'6" high,
  • Trailer over 48' long

Special Information Needed

  • N/A

Times Of Movement

  • 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset
  • Vehicles that are overweight only shall not be restricted to the time of travel
  • Travel prohibited on the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Washington’s Birthday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day,Thanksgiving, Christmas (If a holiday falls on a Sumday, the following Monday will be considered the holiday; if it falls on a Saturday, the previous Friday will be considered th e holiday) Permit office will be closed on these holidays plus the day after Thanksgiving.

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • http://www.nh.gov/dot/highwaymaintenance/pdf/oversizedvehicles.pdf

Less Than 4-Lane Highways:

  • 12' wide & over-1 front
  • 80' long & over-1 front
  • Overhang 15' & over w/12' width-2 (front & rear)

4-Lane Highways :

  • 12' wide & over-1 rear
  • 80' long & over-1 rear
  • Overhang 15' & over w/12' width- 2 (front & rear)
  • Police Escort Required When :
  • Over 18' wide & over 100' long
  • Mobiles/modulars are restricted to 16' wide & 95' long

Less Than 4-Lane Highways:

  • 12' wide or less-1 front,
  • 12' to 14'6" wide-1 front,
  • Width 14'6" to 16' w/ approved routes-2 sp+.

4-Lane Highways:

  • 12' wide to 14'6" (within 2 miles of an exit from such hwy)-1 rear;
  • Width 14'6" to 16' with approved route-2 sp+

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: No smaller than a compact car or pickup truck
  • Signs: Shape may be varied to fit vehicle (min. 5’ x 12”);”OVERSIZE LOAD” w/ black letters (10” high w/ 1.4” brush stroke) on yellow backgroundmounted on front and/or rear of vehicle
  • Lights: Top mounted flashing or rotating amber lights
  • Flags: None stipulated
  • Additional equipment: 2-way radio

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • None stipulated

Dept. of Transportation Permits Office

  • Dept. of Transportation
  • OS/OW Permits
  • Box 0483
  • Concord, NH 03302
  • 603-271-2691
  • Fax: 603-271-6084 (permits)
  • Office hours: 8:00am-4:00pm ET; M-F
